title: Destiny
overview: Yuzu dreams of being loved by someone, since her family has always cast her aside.

title: Special Someone
overview: Reiya brings Yuzu to his home and announces that she is his bride.

title: Decision
overview: Karin returns to her parents' house to collect personal items and finalize her adoption by her grandparents.

title: Is Their Love for Their Brides Eternal?
overview: As Reiya provides Yuzu with everything she needs, she is reluctant to become too dependent on him.

title: My Rival is a Capable Secretary
overview: Yuzu begins working for Reiya and learns more about his relationship with his secretary Takamichi.

title: Touko and Nyankichi
overview: While Yuzu puzzles over her feelings for Reiya, Touko explains how she and Nyankichi got together.

title: Reiya's Secret Lover
overview: Sakurako visits Yuzu and warns her not to get between Reiya and Takamichi.

title: The Bewitching Visitor
overview: Yuzu's sister and parents break into her grandparents' house and demand that she come home.

title: Self-Awareness
overview: Yuzu confronts Reiya about the rumors she's been hearing.

title: The Demon Banquet
overview: Yuzu attends the demon banquet, where she meets Reiya's parents and runs into her sister.
